Name: EchoWave
Description: Visual checks for network echo and HTTP/HTTPS web services.

com.devdael.echowave.ping.Name: Echo target
com.devdael.echowave.ping.Tooltip: Tap to send an echo. Hold briefly, then release, to review the last result.

com.devdael.echowave.http.Name: Check web service
com.devdael.echowave.http.Tooltip: Tap for an HTTP/HTTPS GET check. Hold and release for the saved result.
